item.title: Man wounded in 2nd stabbing attack on North Carolina commuter train since August
item.description: Police in North Carolina have charged a 33-year-old man with critically injuring another person in a stabbing on a Charlotte commuter train, just a few months after a Ukrainian refugee riding one of the city's trains was killed in an unrelated knife attack.

item.title: Soon no Pearl Harbor survivors will be alive. People turn to other ways to learn about the bombing
item.description: “The idea of not having a survivor there for the first time — I just, I don’t know — it hurt my heart in a way I can’t describe,” said Kimberlee Heinrichs, whose 105-year-old father Ira “Ike” Schab had to cancel plans to fly in from Oregon after falling ill.

item.title: Trump says he’s hosting the Kennedy Center Honors recognizing Stallone, Kiss, Gaynor and others
item.description: Sylvester Stallone, Kiss and Gloria Gaynor are among the luminaries being celebrated Sunday at the annual Kennedy Center Honors, with Donald Trump hosting the show.

item.title: Tens of thousands of dinosaur footprints and swim tracks found in South America
item.description: A total of nearly 18,000 tracks -- including 16,600 footprints as well as 1,378 swim tracks and several tail traces -- have been located along the Carreras Pampa track site, an ancient coastline located in Torotoro National Park in central Bolivia.

item.title: Key GOP senator says he has no objection to releasing video of strike that killed two survivors
item.description: A video of a U.S. military strike on an alleged drug boat in the Caribbean that killed two survivors of the initial attack shows “nothing remarkable,” the Republican who leads the Senate Intelligence Committee said Sunday, and he would not oppose its public release if the Pentagon were to declassify it.

item.title: Where the blame will fall if ACA subsidies expire, according to a new poll
item.description: Most of the more than 1,300 enrollees surveyed in early November say they anticipate that their health costs will be impacted next year if Congress doesn’t extend expiring COVID-era tax credits that help more than 90% of enrollees pay for health insurance premiums, per KFF.

item.description: Founders Park in Leland, re-opens its doors with "Leland in Lights"

item.title: Wreaths were hung along the lifelines of The Battleship North Carolina, to remember those who serve our country
item.description: Wreaths were hung on the North Carolina Battleship, to honor those who serve our country, and our veterans.

item.title: Good safety tips on saving your Christmas tree
item.description: Kevin McDonald shares some good tips on how to take care of your Christmas tree and not let it burn your house.

item.title: City of Wilmington’s holiday parade kicks off the holiday mood
item.description: City of Wilmington's Holiday parade lights up the town on Sunday night. A variety of floats and lights walk down Front Street to bring joy and laughter.
